Live mode requires BOTH explicit env switch and a manually reviewed URL/place manifest.
A location/category group disappears only if all serialized articles were approved and removed.
For capped groups, count and activity metrics may include withheld articles; never enable this pilot on a capped group without verifying the downstream presentation.
d18_controlled_activation.rollback: Set WORLDPULSE_D18_ENABLE_APPROVED_CORRECTIONS=0 (or remove it), or set enable_live_corrections=false in data/d18-reviewed-approvals.json; run the workflow again.

d19_correction_integrity.note: Hypothetical deletions are never published. Full article review and an upstream metrics rebuild are required before live activation. Capped groups are not simulated as safely deletable.

d191_feed_resilience.note: Snapshot health uses serialized article count as a conservative proxy. An old snapshot is not preserved forever; age limit is 30 hours.

frozen_outage_drills.note: Synthetic in-memory scenarios confirm gate decisions and snapshot immutability; they do not simulate network fetches, GitHub commits, or guarantee future source availability.

limits: A successful HTTP response with zero parsed items is not a transport failure; it can still represent an upstream empty or malformed response.
No automatic publication block is introduced for successful empty feeds.
Drills exercise the D19.1 decision helper with synthetic feed statuses, not real HTTP requests.
Geographic corrections remain disabled.
Article review provenance is user-supplied, not authenticated or independently verified by the collector.
Uncapped serialized groups can rebuild their local metrics; capped groups remain blocked.
Projected changes do not rebuild cross-border links, story clusters, feed attribution or persisted history.
No candidate is remapped automatically; live correction remains locked off.

reasons: AI-assisted source review does not constitute human approval
D21 projection cannot guarantee full rebuild of downstream clusters/history/cross-border links
Approval and live filtering are hard-locked out of this release

limits: Derived cluster and cross-border structures are computed in memory, never published
Clustering history enrichment is intentionally excluded to avoid modifying persistent history
Unapproved evidence is used only for comparison, never live removal

deduplication_review.note: Cross-location reuse is not automatically incorrect; preserve separate evidence-backed assignments.
